channel.title: IMD Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS) Agromet Bulletin
channel.description: District-level Agromet Bulletins for Madhya Pradesh

item.title: Agromet Advisory Bulletin: Sehore District
item.description: Forecast: Partly cloudy sky. Maximum temperature 32.5 C, Minimum temperature 21.0 C. Relative humidity 65-75%. Expected rainfall 2.0 mm. Agricultural Advisory: Weather is favorable for harvesting mature Kharif soybean. Sun dry produce to below 12% moisture.

item.title: Agromet Advisory Bulletin: Bhopal District
item.description: Forecast: Clear sky. Maximum temperature 33.0 C, Minimum temperature 22.0 C. Rainfall 0.0 mm. Favorable weather for land preparation and field sowing of early Rabi mustard and toria.
